pages.text: $(thing)Wheat Leaf Rust$() ($(o)Puccinia triticina$()), fungus.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() common wheat, durum wheat.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() airborne spores.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 10-30 °C (best 20 °C), humidity above 80%, 3 h of wet leaves.
$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 0.3 years (volunteer wheat).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 40% yield.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Resistant cultivars (Lr genes); Destroy volunteer wheat; Fungicide.
